rumble.command.description: Runs when a viewer types a command like !hello in your Rumble chat. Cuebot cuts the words after it into variables.

fields.command: The word viewers type, with the ! in front, like "!hello".
fields.match: "Starts with" also runs when the viewer adds words after it ("!so bob"). "Exact" runs only when the message is the command alone.
fields.permission: The lowest role that may use it: Everyone, Subscriber, Moderator or Broadcaster (you). Higher roles can always use it.
fields.globalCooldown: Seconds to wait before anyone can use it again. 0 means no wait. Example: 30.
fields.userCooldown: Seconds each viewer must wait before using it again. 0 means no wait. Example: 60.
fields.caseSensitive: Tick to care about capital letters, so "!Hello" no longer matches "!hello".

variables.input0: The first word after the command (then input1, input2...)
variables.inputCount: How many words came after the command
variables.isModerator: True if they are a moderator
variables.isSubscriber: True if they are a subscriber

rumble.chatMessage.description: Runs when someone writes in your Rumble live chat. Needs a live stream and your Live Stream API link in the Rumble settings.

fields.contains: Only run when the message has this text in it, like "hello". Capital letters do not matter. Leave empty to run for every message.

variables.user: Name of the person who wrote
variables.isModerator: True if they are a moderator
variables.isSubscriber: True if they are a subscriber
variables.isRant: True if it was a paid Rant
variables.amount: The Rant amount in dollars (0 if not a Rant)
variables.messageId: ID of the message, when Rumble gives one

rumble.follow.description: Runs when someone follows your Rumble channel. Cuebot checks every few seconds. Good for a thank-you message.

rumble.giftSub.description: Runs when someone gifts subscriptions on your Rumble channel. Use it to thank the gifter.

fields.minTotal: Only run when at least this many subs were gifted. Example: 5.

variables.remaining: How many are left to give out

rumble.rant.description: Runs when a viewer pays for a Rant (a highlighted paid message) in your Rumble chat. Good for a thank-you or an alert.

fields.minAmount: Only run for at least this many dollars. 0 runs for every Rant. Example: 5.

variables.amount: How many dollars, as a number
variables.amountText: The amount with the dollar sign, like $5.00
variables.message: The text that came with it

rumble.streamOffline.description: Runs when your Rumble stream ends. Handy for a goodbye message.

rumble.streamOnline.description: Runs when your Rumble stream goes live. Use it to say hello or switch scenes.

rumble.subscribe.description: Runs when someone subscribes to your Rumble channel. Good for a thank-you message or alert.

variables.amount: What they pay, in dollars (0 if Rumble does not say)
variables.amountText: The amount with the dollar sign, like $5.00

rumble.sendMessage.description: Writes a message in your Rumble live chat. Needs you to be signed in to Rumble chat and live right now.
